# 💳 Post-Mortem Setup (gws CLI)

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — a step-by-step incident workflow recipe: create a post-mortem Doc with Summary, Timeline, Root Cause and Action Items sections, schedule the review meeting in Calendar, and announce it in a Chat space. Distinct from the sibling recipe create-events-from-sheet: that one bulk-creates calendar events from spreadsheet rows; this one orchestrates a full incident-review workflow across Docs, Calendar and Chat. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: the recipe assumes the gws-docs, gws-calendar and gws-chat utility skills are loaded and the gws binary is installed and authenticated; it scaffolds the process — the actual incident analysis still has to be written by a human or the agent. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
